name: claude-app-bootstrap
description: Single-plugin marketplace hosting the app-bootstrap methodology plugin.

plugins.name: app-bootstrap
plugins.description: A five-stage methodology for taking an app from an idea to shipped code: product discovery, user journeys (stage 1b: personas and journeys written blind, mapped, reviewed, drawn as one map), wireframes, an adversarial design loop, a phased implementation loop, and end-to-end review.
